Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported
in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the details, if that's alright. I'm the driver who was hit from behind.
Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?
A: I was stopped at a traffic light, waiting for the signal to change. I had been stopped for myabe half a minute when I
felt the car get shoved forward hard.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was. The belt locked up and pulled me back, and my right shoulder took most of it.
Q: Did you notice the other vehicle before the collision?
A: No. I was looking ahead at the light. I only saw it in my mirror after it hit me, and by then there wasn't time to do
anything.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?
A: I did, but I felt stiff and sore, so I sat down on the curb until the officer arrived. My neck was tight, but the shoulder
pain was the worst.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic the same evening and was referred to an orthopedic doctor. They told me I
might have a soft tissue injury to the shoulder and I'm scheduled for imaging.
Q: Are you currently missing any work because of the injury?
A: I've been limited. I drive for a living, so I've had to take a few days off while I'm getting the shoulder looked at. I'm
keeping records of the missed shifts.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want the medical bills and lost wages documented properly. I'm trying to do the right thing here.
Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the statement.
</page>

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
